Facts: Bear (熊某) and others kidnapped (非法拘禁) 陈某, beat him (殴打) causing轻微伤, extorted money (30000, 9900) and demanded gun and armor, also took gold necklace as collateral. This is kidnapping/illegal detention, extortion (敲诈勒索?), robbery? They used force to take money and property. The act: they detained, beat, and forced victim to pay money and hand over property. This seems to be "非法拘禁" (illegal detention) and "敲诈勒索" (extortion/robbery). In Chinese criminal law, extortion by threatening to cause harm is "敲诈勒索罪". Also "抢夺" is theft by force, but they used kidnapping and extortion. The examples: For similar case of kidnapping and extortion, they used "敲诈勒索". Example earlier: "葛某...敲诈勒索" (threatening to harm). Here they used physical force and kidnapping to extort money. So charge: "非法拘禁;敲诈勒索". Also possibly "抢夺" but they didn't just snatch property; they forced victim to give money under duress. That's extortion. So answer: [罪名]非法拘禁;敲诈勒索<eoa>
